provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-aligned batch (2026-10-21): rules shaped by the Main App response surface
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A hardened application page must not trigger any app-aligned detection.

groundTruth.rationale: The page is served over HTTPS with a full security header set, no cookie, and a body whose text mentions the words database and error without any driver, framework or file marker. A detector that fires here is reading prose, not evidence.

observation.body:
Payment help

If a payment fails the application shows a generic database error code and a support reference. We never render the driver message.

Our stack uses SQL and a framework data layer, both behind an error handler.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
All 12 rules from the app-aligned batch are named as forbidden, not a hand-picked subset; no rule was removed after the first run.
